summary: The cut strip is clean, with no pops, flicker or clipping, but the seated figure is almost frozen and shows no sign yet of "he finally looks up".

faults.what: From 10.16 to 10.40 the head, eyes and expression barely change. He holds a flat stare with a stiff torso and no visible look-up beat or anticipation, so the 'finally looks up' idea doesn't read yet.
faults.fix: Add a small head tilt and eye lead, or a blink, in the first few frames of the shot. This sets up the look-up.
